init_hook: rustup toolchain list | grep -q "^${RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN}" || rustup toolchain install "${RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN}" --profile minimal
rustup target list --installed --toolchain "${RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN}" | grep -qx wasm32-unknown-unknown || rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown --toolchain "${RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN}"
rustup component list --toolchain "${RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN}" | grep -qx 'rustfmt-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu (installed)' || rustup component add rustfmt --toolchain "${RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN}"
if [ ! -x "$HOME/.cargo/bin/wasm-bindgen" ] || ! "$HOME/.cargo/bin/wasm-bindgen" --version 2>/dev/null | grep -qx 'wasm-bindgen 0.2.118'; then cargo install -f wasm-bindgen-cli --version 0.2.118; fi

check: RUSTC="$(rustup which --toolchain "${RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN:-stable}" rustc)" cargo check --workspace --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
ci: RUSTC="$(rustup which --toolchain "${RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN:-stable}" rustc)" cargo check --workspace --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
